verdict.rationale: Cerebras Inference is a hosted API, so it runs headlessly by design. Key-authenticated API calls, an official Python SDK and a server-side Node SDK, OpenAI-compatible endpoints, an asynchronous Batch API and a Management API all support scripted, non-interactive automation. A community user also drove it from the command line through the llm-cerebras plugin, but another hit request-per-minute limits immediately when integrating it into a coding-agent workflow. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs or examples, an official first-party CLI, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent reports of CI usage without rate-limit friction.
